name: procta-sucrase-build
description: Self-contained build of the bundled Sucrase TypeScript transpiler for the kiosk coding question. Emits ../../renderer/sucrase.bundle.js (committed). Sucrase is pure JS (no WASM) so it loads under the kiosk CSP with no relaxation. node_modules here is gitignored — run `npm install && npm run build` to regenerate.
